instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Joseph likes to bake. Ever since he can remember, Joseph has been baking with his grandma. His grandma is a real professional.
atoms.sound: ssml: Joseph’s grandma. <break time='800ms'/>Joseph likes to bake. <break time='600ms'/> Ever since he can remember, Joseph has been baking with his grandma. <break time='600ms'/> His grandma is a real professional.

b: ++Joseph likes to bake with his grandma.
Joseph’s grandma is not very good at baking.

atoms.text: His grandma can make a hundred recipes without ever looking in a cookbook! She knows all sorts of secrets that make her biscuits better than anyone else’s.
atoms.sound: ssml: His grandma can make a hundred recipes without ever looking in a cookbook! <break time='600ms'/> She knows all sorts of secrets that make her biscuits better than anyone else’s.

atoms.text: Joseph likes spending time with his grandma. His grandma knows a lot of jokes, and they are constantly teasing each other.
atoms.sound: ssml: Joseph likes spending time with his grandma. <break time='600ms'/>His grandma knows a lot of jokes, and they are constantly teasing each other.

b: Joseph’s grandma is very serious and has forgotten a lot of recipes.
++Joseph grandma knows baking secrets, and they like to tease each other.

atoms.text: Grandma always asks Joseph, “Why did the birthday cake have to go to the doctors?” Joseph knows the answer, but always asks anyway, “I don’t know grandma, tell me!”
atoms.sound: ssml: grandma always asks Joseph, <voice voice='f4_2025'> “Why did the birthday cake have to go to the doctors?” </voice> <break time='600ms'/>Joseph knows the answer, but always asks anyway, <voice voice='m3_2025'> “I don’t know grandma, tell me!” </voice>

atoms.text: “Because it was feeling crumby!” and then grandma would laugh and Joseph too. Joseph really loves his grandma.

b: Joseph thinks his grandma is very funny, but does not like the joke about cake.
++Joseph and his grandma love spending time baking and telling jokes together.
